verses.text: Of David. Bless, O my soul, YHWH, and all within me—His holy name!

segments.text: Of David. Bless, O my soul, YHWH, and all within me—His holy name!

verses.text: O my soul, bless YHWH, and do not forget all His benefits—

segments.text: O my soul, bless YHWH, and do not forget all His benefits—

verses.text: the One forgiving all your iniquities, the One healing all your diseases,

segments.text: the One forgiving all your iniquities, the One healing all your diseases,

verses.text: the One redeeming your life from destruction, the One crowning you with loving devotion and compassion,

segments.text: the One redeeming your life from destruction, the One crowning you with loving devotion and compassion,

verses.text: the One filling your beauty with the good; your youth is renewed like the eagle.

segments.text: the One filling your beauty with the good; your youth is renewed like the eagle.

verses.text: YHWH is doing righteousness and justice for all being oppressed.

segments.text: YHWH is doing righteousness and justice for all being oppressed.

verses.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.

segments.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.

verses.text: Compassionate and gracious [is] YHWH, slow [to] anger and abounding [in] loving devotion.

segments.text: Compassionate and gracious [is] YHWH, slow [to] anger and abounding [in] loving devotion.

verses.text: He will not contend forever, and He will not keep [it] forever.

segments.text: He will not contend forever, and He will not keep [it] forever.

verses.text: He has not done to us according to our sins, and He has not dealt with us according to our iniquities.

segments.text: He has not done to us according to our sins, and He has not dealt with us according to our iniquities.

verses.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, [so] His loving devotion is mighty for those fearing Him.

segments.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, [so] His loving devotion is mighty for those fearing Him.

verses.text: As far as the east [is] from the west, [so] has He put our transgressions far from us.

segments.text: As far as the east [is] from the west, [so] has He put our transgressions far from us.

verses.text: As a father has compassion for [his] children, [so] YHWH has compassion for those fearing Him.

segments.text: As a father has compassion for [his] children, [so] YHWH has compassion for those fearing Him.

verses.text: For He knows our form; He remembers that we [are] dust.

segments.text: For He knows our form; He remembers that we [are] dust.

verses.text: A man—his days [are] like grass; like the flower of the field, so he blossoms;

segments.text: A man—his days [are] like grass; like the flower of the field, so he blossoms;

verses.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is no more; and its place does not recognize it anymore.

segments.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is no more; and its place does not recognize it anymore.

verses.text: But the loving devotion of YHWH [is] from forever and even to forever upon those fearing Him, and His righteousness to the sons of the sons—

segments.text: But the loving devotion of YHWH [is] from forever and even to forever upon those fearing Him, and His righteousness to the sons of the sons—

verses.text: to those keeping His covenant, and to those remembering His precepts, to do them.

segments.text: to those keeping His covenant, and to those remembering His precepts, to do them.

verses.text: YHWH has established His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom rules over all.

segments.text: YHWH has established His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom rules over all.

verses.text: Bless YHWH, His angels, mighty of strength, doing His word, to listen to the voice of His word.

segments.text: Bless YHWH, His angels, mighty of strength, doing His word, to listen to the voice of His word.

verses.text: Bless YHWH, all His hosts, His ministering ones doing His pleasure.

segments.text: Bless YHWH, all His hosts, His ministering ones doing His pleasure.

verses.text: Bless YHWH, all His works, in all places of His dominion. O my soul, bless YHWH!
